strings: Initially there was some confusion over why m_c wasn't speaking, it's soon cleared up that there's nothing wrong {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} just mute.
m_c has never needed words to speak, fluent enough with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} body language and the Clan adapts to help {PRONOUN/m_c/object} be heard even in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} silence.
Nobody knew silence could be so loud until m_c arrived.

When m_c's parents come in with {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to visit r_c it's about worries with {PRONOUN/m_c/object} not speaking. After some tests r_c sits back and gently explains it's likely that m_c's mute.
